mashups.title: Minecraft in Skyrim
mashups.name: SkyCraft
mashups.author: chasmlol

needs.help: Download the build for your Skyrim version and copy its files next to SkyrimSE.exe.
Get the "All in one (Anniversary Edition)" file from Nexus Mods and install it with your mod manager.

mashups.requires: Skyrim Special Edition 1.6 or 1.7 (not 1.5.97 or VR), and a Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition. The first start asks you to sign in and downloads Minecraft (about 1.5 GB). It uses about 3 GB more memory. Start from a save made after Helgen, or use Alternate Start.
mashups.blurb: Real Minecraft runs hidden next to Skyrim and takes over movement, mining, building, crafting, hunger and combat, while Skyrim draws the world and keeps its people, quests and saves. Friends with their own copy can join your Minecraft world. Early and experimental.

mashups.title: Minecraft in Elden Ring
mashups.name: EldenCraft
mashups.author: SocketByte
mashups.requires: Elden Ring on Steam, updated to 1.17.1 (EldenCraft refuses any other version), and a Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition. It plays offline only: Elden Ring starts with online play and Easy Anti-Cheat off, on a separate save. The first start downloads Minecraft, Java and its tools and asks you to sign in.
mashups.blurb: Minecraft and Elden Ring run together and are drawn as one picture: the Lands Between, its enemies and bosses, with Minecraft's blocks, inventory, tools, crafting and HUD. Your Elden Ring game files are never changed. Early alpha.

mashups.title: Minecraft in The Witcher 3
mashups.name: WitcherCraft
mashups.author: Wanesia
mashups.requires: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt next-gen (patch 5.0 or 5.01) on Steam, and a Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition. The first start opens Prism Launcher to sign in and download Minecraft, then closes the game: start it again. Needs 16 GB of memory, keyboard and mouse. Turn off Frame Generation.
mashups.blurb: Built on SkyCraft: play The Witcher 3 as Steve, with Minecraft's movement, blocks, mining and combat in Geralt's world. F8 switches back to Geralt. Very early.

mashups.title: Minecraft in Trepang2
mashups.name: DeadPixel
mashups.author: ImmortalSouull
mashups.requires: Trepang2 on Steam, and Minecraft: Java Edition with the official Minecraft Launcher. In DeadPixel press INSTALL once, then play; Trepang2 starts once Minecraft has loaded its world. Single player only.
mashups.blurb: Minecraft's blocks, mobs and TNT appear inside Trepang2: bullets chew through blocks, Focus slows Minecraft down too, and zombies fight Trepang2's soldiers.

mashups.title: Minecraft in Ready or Not
mashups.name: BlockBreach
mashups.author: ImmortalSouull
mashups.requires: Ready or Not on Steam, running in DirectX 11, and Minecraft: Java Edition with the official Minecraft Launcher. BlockBreach finds both and starts Ready or Not once Minecraft has opened its world. Single player only.
mashups.blurb: Minecraft's world, blocks and mobs inside Ready or Not's close-quarters missions, from the maker of DeadPixel.

mashups.title: Mario 64 in Garry's Mod
mashups.name: G64
mashups.author: ckosmic

needs.help: In Steam, open Garry's Mod's Properties, Betas, and choose "x86-64 - Chromium + 64-bit binaries".

mashups.requires: Subscribe to the G64 addon on the Steam Workshop, and have your own Super Mario 64 ROM (US version); set its path in the spawn menu under Utilities, G64, Settings.
mashups.blurb: Spawn a playable Mario with Super Mario 64's real movement (libsm64) in any Garry's Mod map, multiplayer included.

mashups.title: Doom in Stardew Valley
mashups.name: DoomValley
mashups.author: wojciech-graj

needs.help: Run the SMAPI installer and point it at your Stardew Valley folder.
Put a Doom WAD (the free shareware DOOM1.WAD works) in Mods\DoomValley inside your Stardew Valley folder.

mashups.requires: Stardew Valley on Steam with SMAPI, and a Doom WAD (the free shareware one is enough).
mashups.blurb: A Doom arcade machine in Stardew Valley that runs the real Doom engine (doomgeneric). No sound yet.

mashups.title: Doom in Erenshor
mashups.name: ErenshorDoom
mashups.author: xJeris

needs.help: Download BepInEx 5.4 for Windows x64 and unzip it next to Erenshor.exe.
Put DOOM1.WAD (the free shareware one from that link, or your own) in BepInEx\plugins\ErenshorDoom.

mashups.requires: Erenshor on Steam with BepInEx 5, and a Doom WAD (the free shareware one is enough).
mashups.blurb: The real Doom engine (Managed Doom) runs in a window inside Erenshor. Open it with /doom or F9 while the world keeps going around you.

mashups.title: Mario 64 in Shadow Gambit
mashups.name: Shadow Mario
mashups.author: CrabNickolson

needs.help: Download "BepInEx Unity (IL2CPP) for Windows (x64) games" from the newest build (or #682 if that fails) and unzip it next to ShadowGambit_TCC.exe.
Unzip the com.crabnickolson.pirate_base zip into BepInEx\plugins.
Copy your own Super Mario 64 (USA) ROM into BepInEx\plugins and name it baserom.us.z64.

mashups.requires: Shadow Gambit 1.2.133 on Steam, a controller, and your own Super Mario 64 ROM. The first start takes a few minutes; use a new save profile.
mashups.blurb: Swap any of your crew for Super Mario 64's Mario (libsm64): punch, stomp and ground-pound through stealth missions.
